description.zh: App编号，系统生成，全局唯一
description.en: The application ID, which is generated by the system and globally unique.

description.zh: 指定要查询的页码，默认是1，起始是1
description.en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 指定分页查询时每页行数，最大值100，默认值为10
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向API使用者
- App可以调用查询结果返回的所有API
descriptions.en:
- This operation is intended for API callers.

- The specified application can call all APIs included in the responses.
